🗞️ Need to catch up on the news? Here's our top 10 from today:

🔸 White House crypto advisor Patrick Witt says, “The administration remains fully committed to getting the Clarity Act across the finish line in September.”

🔹 Trump Media said more than 10 customers, mostly high-frequency trading firms, have signed up for its real-time Truth Social data feed, per WSJ.

🔸 Europe released a set of standardized icons that platforms can use to label AI-generated or manipulated content under the EU AI Act's transparency rules.

🔹 Anthropic struck a $9.1 billion cloud deal with Bitcoin miner Riot Platforms, per Bloomberg.

🔸 The SEC will hold an open meeting on Friday to consider proposing new rules for a tailored offering regime covering crypto investment contracts.

🔹 TRUMP: “The only one that has control of the Strait of Hormuz right now is the United States Navy... We control the Strait 100%."

🔸 Trump Media disclosed it holds 14,139 $BTC worth roughly $900 million after adding 4,662 BTC in July.

🔹 BlackRock CEO Larry Fink says AI will require more than 70 gigawatts of power.

🔸 Sui introduced Tessera, a KYC-gated B2B settlement network using confidential stablecoin transfers to keep payment amounts private.

🔹 Wall Street giants partner with Nvidia on a $500 billion AI financing deal, according to the Financial Times.
